class.name: DisRadioMonitor
class.brief_description: Keeps track of the radios on the network and who is transmitting, from Transmitter and Signal PDUs.
class.description: Listens to [signal DisNetwork.transmitter_received] and [signal DisNetwork.signal_received] of a [DisNetwork] (found through the group [code]dis_network[/code] unless [member network_path] is set) and keeps a table of radios, identified by the entity that carries them and the radio number. No audio is decoded or played. A radio counts as transmitting while its last [DisTransmitterPdu] says "on and transmitting" ([constant DisTransmitterPdu.TRANSMIT_ON_AND_TRANSMITTING]) or while a [DisSignalPdu] from it arrived less than [member signal_hold] seconds ago. A radio that is not heard from (no Transmitter and no Signal PDU) for [member timeout] seconds is forgotten. The table is updated every frame; nothing runs in the editor. [codeblock] $DisRadioMonitor.transmission_started.connect( func(entity_id: Vector3i, radio: int, frequency: int): print("%s transmits on %.3f MHz" % [entity_id, frequency / 1e6])) [/codeblock]

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets all radios without emitting [signal radio_removed] or [signal transmission_ended].

method.name: get_dropped_count
method.description: Returns how many Transmitter or Signal PDUs of new radios were dropped because [member max_radios] was reached.

method.name: get_radios
method.description: Returns an [Array] of [Dictionary], one per known radio, with the keys: - [code]entity_id[/code]: [Vector3i] ID of the entity carrying the radio. - [code]radio_number[/code]: radio number within that entity. - [code]frequency[/code]: centre frequency in Hz from the last Transmitter PDU, or [code]0[/code] if only Signal PDUs were seen. - [code]transmit_state[/code]: transmit state from the last Transmitter PDU (see the [code]TRANSMIT_*[/code] constants of [DisTransmitterPdu]), or [code]-1[/code] if none was seen. - [code]power[/code]: transmitted power in dBm, or [code]0.0[/code] if no Transmitter PDU was seen. - [code]transmitting[/code]: whether the radio is transmitting now. - [code]signal_count[/code]: number of Signal PDUs received from the radio. - [code]seconds_since_heard[/code]: seconds since the last Transmitter or Signal PDU.

method.name: get_transmitting_entities
method.description: Returns an [Array] of the entity IDs ([Vector3i]) that have at least one radio transmitting now, each listed once.

method.name: handle_pdu
method.description: Applies a [DisTransmitterPdu] or [DisSignalPdu] as if it had been received from the network; other PDU types are ignored. The node already does this for the PDUs of its [DisNetwork]; use this to feed PDUs from another source.

method.name: is_transmitting
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any radio of the entity [param entity_id] is transmitting now.

method.name: update
method.description: Updates the transmitting state of every radio from the current time and forgets radios not heard from for [member timeout] seconds, emitting the matching signals. Called automatically every frame.

members.member: Maximum number of radios in the table. Transmitter and Signal PDUs of further new radios are dropped (see [method get_dropped_count]) and a warning is printed once. [code]0[/code] means no limit.
Path to the [DisNetwork] to listen to. If empty, the first node in the group [code]dis_network[/code] is used. Changing it while in the tree reconnects.
Time in seconds a radio keeps counting as transmitting after its last Signal PDU, if its Transmitter PDU does not say "on and transmitting".
Time in seconds without any Transmitter or Signal PDU after which a radio is removed.

signal.name: radio_added
signal.description: Emitted when a radio is first heard. [param entity_id] is the ID of the entity carrying it and [param radio_number] its radio number.

signal.name: radio_removed
signal.description: Emitted when a radio is removed because it was not heard from for [member timeout] seconds. [param entity_id] and [param radio_number] identify it. Not emitted by [method clear].

signal.name: transmission_ended
signal.description: Emitted when a radio stops transmitting, including when it is removed while transmitting. [param entity_id] and [param radio_number] identify the radio. Not emitted by [method clear].

signal.name: transmission_started
signal.description: Emitted when a radio starts transmitting. [param entity_id] and [param radio_number] identify the radio and [param frequency] is its centre frequency in Hz from the last Transmitter PDU, or [code]0[/code] if none was received.
